text.tspan: Route /appointments. Every booking the patient has made, online or through the front desk.

g.text: Lumina Specialized Hospital · UI wireframes v0.1 · October 2026

text.tspan: Your slot with Dr. Tanvir Hasan on Sat, 10
Oct at 5:42 PM will be released.
Two lists: upcoming, and past or cancelled.
On the day of the appointment a “Live queue” button
Reschedule opens the doctor’s slots. The old slot is
released only when the new one is confirmed.
Cancelling asks first. The slot is released at once
and the patient gets an SMS.
“Book again” opens the same doctor’s slots.
Cancelled bookings say why: by the patient, by the
hospital, doctor on leave, or moved to another slot.
